patches.description: No-ops after-call ad update sites (Lcom/truecaller/acs/ui/baz;->Rh and Ltw1/f;->Th).

patches.name: Truecaller — strip outbound SMS watermark (STUB)
patches.description: STUB: remove the "Sent via Truecaller" trailer from outbound SMS. Fingerprints not yet discovered.

patches.name: Truecaller — strip third-party analytics + ad SDKs
patches.description: No-ops third-party telemetry, ad-network, and tracking SDK init calls (Clarity, CleverTap, AppsFlyer, Moloco, HMS, Freshchat, InMobi, Appnext, Vungle, Fyber, Mintegral, IronSource, HyBid, MLKit, Presence stream).
